name: withdrawal
description: Crypto withdrawal from an exchange account
subject: user
hold: Should the pending withdrawal be held for manual review because the account shows signs of account takeover, of money mule activity, or of the customer being a scam victim?

typologies.ato: Account takeover: a person other than the account holder controls the account
typologies.scam: Scam victim: the account holder makes the withdrawal personally but a scammer directs it
typologies.mule: Money mule or fraud ring: the account exists to receive illicit funds and move them on
typologies.legit: Legitimate withdrawal by the account holder for their own purposes

reasons.new_device: The current session uses a device that the account did not use before
reasons.new_location: The current login is from a country or city that is unusual for the account
reasons.new_destination: The withdrawal goes to a destination address that was added recently
reasons.unusual_hour: The activity occurs at a time of day that is unusual for the account
reasons.security_change: A password reset, a two-factor change or a notification change occurred shortly before the withdrawal
reasons.full_balance: The withdrawal takes most or all of the account balance
reasons.rapid_liquidation: Assets were sold quickly and immediately before the withdrawal
reasons.deposit_spike: Recent bank deposits are much larger than the usual deposits of the account
reasons.pass_through: Recently deposited funds are sent out again shortly after they arrive
reasons.third_party_direction: A message from the customer suggests that another person directs the transfer
reasons.risky_device_links: The device is linked to other accounts that have fraud or takeover reports
reasons.risky_destination_links: The destination address also receives funds from other customers who have scam or fraud reports
